### The King’s Heart in God’s Hand
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/the-kings-heart-in-gods-hand
Passage: Proverbs 21:1
Points:
- Serving under bosses and authority figures is often difficult, especially for developing leaders.
- God holds the hearts of all superiors in His hands and directs them according to His purpose.
- Nehemiah responded to earthly authority by praying patiently for four months before speaking to King Artaxerxes.
- God answered Nehemiah's prayers by moving the king's heart to grant his request to rebuild Jerusalem.
- Believers can place difficult authority figures in God's hands and wait peacefully for Him to work.

### Displays of Divine Providence
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-february-17-2023.html
Passage: Proverbs 21:1
Points:
- Proverbs 21:1 offers a clear picture of God's overarching providence across the universe.
- God channels human decisions and even rebellious rulers to accomplish His ultimate redemptive purposes.
- The flourishing of wicked leaders does not mean God has lost control or been defeated.
- The Lord frequently uses worldly authorities and adverse circumstances to refine or protect His people.
- Believers can rest with confidence in their heavenly Father's care even in confusing times.

### Our Wisdom and God's
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-wisdom-and-gods
Passage: Proverbs 21:30-31
Points:
- Sin is fundamentally irrational because human beings cannot dethrone or outsmart the Creator.
- Only the regenerating work of the Holy Spirit can humble human pride to submit to God's wisdom.
- No human understanding, strategy, or counsel can successfully oppose the Lord.
- While it is wise to make diligent plans, final success and victory depend entirely on God.
- Believers can rejoice knowing that the sovereign, invincible God is on their side.
